full_judgment: Md Showkat Ali, Md Dabir Uddin and Md Shomser Ali all sons of late Rofetullah were the original owners of 49 decimals of land appertaining to SA Khatian No.826, SA Plot No.5823. Out of said 49 decimals of land, Md Shomser Ali vide Hiba-bil-iwaz Deed No.11502 dated 25-3-1963 transferred 25 decimals of land to his son Md Jamal Uddin who mutated the same in his name being Holding No.690. It is stated that since Jamal Uddin was minor, land development tax was paid in his father's name up to 1424 BS and he was in possession of the same by constructing house. When Jamal Uddin became ill, the writ petitioner rendered nursing service to him including necessary treatment. Being satisfied with the nursing service rendered by the petitioner, Jamal Uddin transferred the case property to the writ petitioner vide Hiba-bil-iwaz Deed No. 8097 dated 22-11-2017. The petitioner mutated the case property in his name by opening separate Holding No.5564 vide Mutation Case No.1018/17-18. Thereafter, on 31-1-2018 respondent Nos. 7 to 10 as petitioners filed Miscellaneous Case No. 23 of 2017-2018 before the Assistant Commissioner (Land), Nilphamari, District-Nilphamari for cancellation of writ petitioner's Mutation Case No.1018 of 2017-18 on the ground that he got the case property mutated in his name by creating false and forged documents vide Annexure-B to the writ petition. On the basis of the allegation, the Assistant Commissioner (Land) issued letter dated 20-2-2018 to the District Registrar, Rangpur requesting him to send a report as to the genuineness of the Hiba-bil-iwaz Deed No.11502 dated 25-3-1963. Accordingly, on 4-3-2018 the Sub-Registrar, Sadar, Rangpur sent a report stating that the alleged deed was rightly registered on 25-3-1963 but the concerned page of the volume being torn and damaged, information regarding the parties to the deed, mouza, area of land, khatian and plot number could not be possible to supply vide Annexures-C and C-1 to the writ petition. Thereafter, Jamal Uddin who has gifted the suit property to the writ petitioner filed an application before the Sub Registrar, Sadar, Rangpur asking information about the Hiba-bil-iwaz Deed No.11502 dated 25-3-1963 whereupon the Sub-Registrar, Sadar, Rangpur vide his report dated 4-4-2018 informed that the alleged deed was rightly registered on 25-3-1963 but due to the concerned page of the volume being torn and damaged information as prayed for could not be supplied vide Annexure-D to the writ petition.
